comments.body: For those doing the Solstice event, British Isles South Coast landing has this and no other junk drops (common grass / sand) - just spam Search near the entry point until you've gathered your fill. Otherwise Baltic Sea South-East Coast landing has it, in addition to common grass. Cheers.
